title: At the information desk
instructions: Bir turist istasyondaki danışmada bilgi alıyor. Saat, peron ve bilet fiyatına dikkat et.

script.speaker: tourist
script.text: Excuse me. When is the next train to Brighton?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The next one is at eleven fifteen.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: About one hour. It arrives at twelve fifteen.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: A single is twenty pounds, and a return is thirty.

script.speaker: tourist
script.text: I want to come back tonight, so a return, please. Where can I buy it?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: At the machines over there, or on the app.

questions.prompt: What time is the next train to Brighton?
questions.feedback: Sonraki tren on biri çeyrek geçe (eleven fifteen). 12:15 varış saati.
questions.evidence: The next one is at eleven fifteen.

questions.prompt: Which platform does it leave from?
How much is a return ticket?
questions.feedback: Tek yön yirmi, gidiş-dönüş otuz pound.

questions.prompt: Where can the tourist buy a ticket?
options: at the machines or on the app
questions.feedback: Biletler oradaki makinelerden ya da uygulamadan alınıyor.
questions.evidence: At the machines over there, or on the app.
